newsitem.title: USA: ITT Industries unit raises stake in Spanish firm.
newsitem.headline: ITT Industries unit raises stake in Spanish firm.

text.p: ITT Fluid Technology Corp, a unit of ITT Industries Inc, said Monday it now holds a majority stake in privately-held Tecnicas de Filtracion y Bombeo, SA, a leading producer of submersible pumps in Spain.
ITT Fluid, the world's largest pump producer, said it previously held a small minority stake in the joint venture company.
The ITT Industries unit did not disclose terms of the transaction.
It said that Tecnicas de Filtracion, which is based in Madrid, has 29 sales and service centers throughout Spain and had 1996 revenues of about $20 million.
ITT Industries, a global diversified manufacturer, has core businesses in fluid technology, automotive and defense and electronics.
